messages:
Olivia H: Hey finance, quick one 1: had to buy an umbrella and a travel adaptor at SFO kiosk after luggage got soaked and a client insisted we step outside. Corporate card was declined, paid $46.20 on personal card. No printed receipt, just a small till slip with barcode and partial merchant name. Can I get reimbursed fast?
Sam T: Sorry that happened. We can reimburse personal-pay emergency buys if tied to a client meeting or safety. Need: photo of the till slip, short note of business purpose, and attendee or approver name. Fast-track possible with `EXP-FAST`.
Olivia H: Uploaded a phone pic of the slip to the expense app — it shows "SFO KIOSK #12" and amount but no merchant address. Also attached a DM from Marta saying she saw the incident and told me to buy it.
Marta G: Confirming I told Olivia to pick up the umbrella. Client call was on the apron and we couldn't get inside. Approving reimbursement.
Olivia H: One nuance 1: the kiosk only printed a small barcode slip and the card processor prints "CARD TXN APPROVED" but no VAT or business header. Is that ok?
Sam T: Fine. For small emergency purchases under $75 we accept the kiosk slip plus approver confirmation. For amounts >$75 we'd need a clearer merchant invoice. Tag the expense `travel/sfo` and title it `EXP-FAST: SFO kiosk umbrella`.
Trevor L: Quick Q: do we reimburse taxes on these kinds of purchases? The slip includes total only.
Sam T: Yes reimburse full amount including tax. If the card company did a currency conversion surcharge (rare at SFO), we won't reimburse the markup, but that's not applicable for USD.
Expenses Bot: Reminder 1: upload till slip and approver confirmation under category `travel/sfo` to enable EXP-FAST processing. Missing approver will block the fast-track.
Olivia H: Filed EXP-8109, tagged EXP-FAST, attached till slip photo and Marta's DM screenshot. Note: "umbrella + adaptor purchased during client site visit; approver Marta G"
Sam T: Received EXP-8109. Finance Ops will aim to reimburse within 3 business days under fast-track. I'll also mark the transaction as cleared so it doesn't block month-end reconciliation.
Marta G: Thanks Olivia. Sorry about the rain :umbrella_with_rain_drops:.
Olivia H: All good 1: thanks team, appreciate the speedy response.
Sam T: If anyone else needs quick buys at airports, consider carrying a backup kit in the travel stash. We'll add a note in travel docs.
Olivia H: Good idea, thanks.
